hints.title: Monthly Volume Pre-Aggregation
hints.text: Precompute monthly totals of ride_distance and ride_duration for all 12 calendar months of 2020, treating months with no rides as 0.

hints.title: Three-Month Forward Rolling Sum
hints.text: Use lead(val, 1) and lead(val, 2) over month order to access values for the next two consecutive calendar months.

hints.title: Rolling Average Calculation
hints.text: Divide the 3-month window sum by 3.0 and round to 2 decimal places. Filter for months 1 through 10.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
WITH RECURSIVE Months AS (
    SELECT 1 AS month
    UNION ALL
    SELECT month + 1 FROM Months WHERE month < 12
),
MonthlyTotals AS (
    SELECT m.month,
           IFNULL(SUM(ar.ride_distance), 0) AS tot_dist,
           IFNULL(SUM(ar.ride_duration), 0) AS tot_dur
    FROM Months m
    LEFT JOIN Rides r ON YEAR(r.requested_at) = 2020 AND MONTH(r.requested_at) = m.month
    LEFT JOIN AcceptedRides ar ON r.ride_id = ar.ride_id
    GROUP BY m.month
)
SELECT month,
       ROUND((tot_dist + LEAD(tot_dist, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month) + LEAD(tot_dist, 2) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / 3.0, 2) AS average_ride_distance,
       ROUND((tot_dur + LEAD(tot_dur, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month) + LEAD(tot_dur, 2) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / 3.0, 2) AS average_ride_duration
FROM MonthlyTotals
WHERE month <= 10
ORDER BY month;
```

complexity.notes: Aggregates rides into 12 monthly totals and applies rolling 3-month window average using lead functions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Joining overlapping 3-month ranges directly causes quadratic self-join explosion.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Window lead expressions over pre-aggregated 12-month table compute rolling metrics in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Pre-aggregation into calendar months followed by window lead rolling average calculations.

WITH RECURSIVE Months AS (
    SELECT 1 AS month
    UNION ALL
    SELECT month + 1 FROM Months WHERE month < 12
),
MonthlyTotals AS (
    SELECT m.month,
           COALESCE(SUM(ar.ride_distance), 0) AS tot_dist,
           COALESCE(SUM(ar.ride_duration), 0) AS tot_dur
    FROM Months m
    LEFT JOIN Rides r ON EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.requested_at) = 2020 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM r.requested_at) = m.month
    LEFT JOIN AcceptedRides ar ON r.ride_id = ar.ride_id
    GROUP BY m.month
)
SELECT month,
       ROUND((tot_dist + LEAD(tot_dist, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month) + LEAD(tot_dist, 2) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / 3.0, 2) AS average_ride_distance,
       ROUND((tot_dur + LEAD(tot_dur, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month) + LEAD(tot_dur, 2) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / 3.0, 2) AS average_ride_duration
FROM MonthlyTotals
WHERE month <= 10
ORDER BY month;

import pandas as pd

def hopper_company_queries_iii(drivers: pd.DataFrame, rides: pd.DataFrame, accepted_rides: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    months_df = pd.DataFrame({'month': list(range(1, 13))})
    rides['requested_at'] = pd.to_datetime(rides['requested_at'])
    merged = rides.merge(accepted_rides, on='ride_id')
    rides_2020 = merged[merged['requested_at'].dt.year == 2020].copy()
    rides_2020['month'] = rides_2020['requested_at'].dt.month
    monthly = rides_2020.groupby('month')[['ride_distance', 'ride_duration']].sum().reset_index()
    full = months_df.merge(monthly, on='month', how='left').fillna(0)
    full['average_ride_distance'] = (
        (full['ride_distance'] + full['ride_distance'].shift(-1) + full['ride_distance'].shift(-2)) / 3.0
    ).round(2)
    full['average_ride_duration'] = (
        (full['ride_duration'] + full['ride_duration'].shift(-1) + full['ride_duration'].shift(-2)) / 3.0
    ).round(2)
    res = full[full['month'] <= 10][['month', 'average_ride_distance', 'average_ride_duration']]
    return res
